text:
Flee the golden gate

of an existence you ignore,

for in this Eden you already adore,

it does not wake among lilies.

If in your candid delirium

our existence pleases you,

may your innocence never know

that this life is... martyrdom.

translation.title: To Miss Matilde R.
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the direct counsel to innocence and the closing ellipsis before martyrdom.
